name: Nikaidou Tomoki
source:
Hobbies: Watching movies, gaming, billiards
Special Skills: Cooking, billiards

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689052]Getchu[/url]]

Tomoki comes from a second-rate family of thieves. According to his parents, if he wants to be first-rate, he has to join up with a member of the Lupin family, but he is determined to make it on his own.
